content.title: Constellation Brands CEO is 'confident' despite declining sales
content.description:
Between the Trump administration's immigration policy changes, tariffs, weakening consumer confidence, and changing attitudes around alcohol, Constellation Brands (STZ) is caught in the crossfire of a multitude of headwinds that are weighing on the beer maker's sales.

Constellation Brands CEO Bill Newlands joins Opening Bid with Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi to discuss what's driving the decline in the Corona and Modelo parent company's sales and his expectations going forward.

To watch more expert insights and analysis on the latest market action, check out more Opening Bid.

content.title: Modelo Maker Feels Tariff Pain
content.summary: Tariff costs are rising for Constellation Brands.  The Modelo-maker now sees tariff-related costs for the fiscal year at $70 million for its beer business and $20 million for its wine division.  Constellation CEO Bill Newlands said in an interview that mounting tariff costs were largely tied to levies on aluminum, which beermakers use for their cans.

content.title: STZ Q3 Deep Dive: Consumer Headwinds, Brand Strategy, and Margin Focus Shape Outlook
content.summary: Beer, wine, and spirits company Constellation Brands (NYSE:STZ) reported Q3 CY2025 results beating Wall Street’s revenue expectations, but sales fell by 15% year on year to $2.48 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $3.63 per share was 6.5% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
